artworks.title: Nancy Cock - Clear Starcher
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman leaning out of a window. She is depicted from the waist up, with her arms crossed on the windowsill, looking to her left. She has prominent eyes, a slightly open mouth, and curly hair framed by a headscarf. She wears a dress with elbow-length sleeves and a beaded necklace. Beside her, there is a birdcage hanging on the wall and a potted plant on the windowsill. The window has a lattice screen. The windowsill is inscribed with "NANCY COCK CLEAR STARCHER." The background is lightly painted.

artworks.title: Studies of a Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: Three human figures are depicted in different poses in a red chalk sketch. The main figure is muscular and leaning forward with the head turned to the left. The head has distinct facial features and hair details. The figure is unclothed, emphasizing anatomical details, and there are no objects or jewelry. Another figure is partially shown facing right, with a third figure outlined in the background. The background is plain, adding depth to the sketch.

artworks.title: Seated Female Figure after the Antique
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's upper body and part of the legs. The figure is seated with a bent posture, one arm resting on a bent knee, and the other arm positioned near the upper body. The sketch does not include detailed facial features or hair. The person's clothing is depicted through light drapery, and there are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain and textured, consistent with aged paper, and the sketch is enclosed within a simple border.

artworks.title: Palazzo della Consultà
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper (marked with stylus)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of a square surrounded by architectural structures. In the distance, there is an ornate building. The scene includes small figures and horse-drawn carriages on the street. On the right side, buildings create depth. The sketch is done with fine, precise pencil strokes highlighting architectural details and perspectives. The color palette is subdued with shades of grey, emphasizing the drawing's lines and forms.

artworks.title: Philippe Cayeux
artworks.artist: Louis-Simon Lempereur after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a man's bust, with the head and shoulders visible. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and closed lips. He has curly, voluminous hair styled in an 18th-century fashion. The man is wearing a formal garment, possibly a coat or robe, without visible embellishments. The image is set within a circular frame with a ribbon-like design at the top. The background is textured, contrasting with the detailed engraving of the man. The name "P. CAYEUX" is printed below the circle. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the man.

artworks.title: Louis-Rene de Caradeuc de la Chalotais
artworks.artist: Pierre Etienne Moitte after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 17.8 x 12.2 cm (7 x 4 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a man looking to the right. He has prominent facial features, including a nose and slightly curved mouth, with focused eyes. His hair is styled in defined curls and he is wearing formal attire indicative of 18th-century fashion. The portrait is surrounded by a decorative element with a bow and leaves, with a detailed gradient background. A plaque at the bottom names him as Louis-René de Caradeuc de La Chalotais and includes his role and birth details in French.

artworks.title: Guillaume Coustou
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18 x 12.4 cm (7 1/16 x 4 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's head and shoulders within an oval frame. The man is in profile facing right, with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and chin, and styled 18th-century hair. He wears a high-collared garment, possibly formal wear or period costume, with visible fabric textures. The background has a textured pattern, contrasting with the shading in the oval frame. At the top of the oval, there is depicted drapery. Text below identifies the subject as Guillaume Coustou, a sculptor of the king.

artworks.title: L. Bay de Curys
artworks.artist: Claude Henri Watelet after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders profile portrait of a man facing to the right, enclosed within a circular frame. He has a prominent nose, high forehead, and tightly curled hair styled back and tied with a ribbon at the nape of his neck. The man wears an 18th-century style coat with a high collar and a cravat. Above the circular frame is a decorative bow. The background is plain and textured, with the name "L. BAY DE CURYS," the year 1759, and the artist's signature inscribed below the circular frame.

artworks.title: Charles Duclos
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 17.6 x 12.9 cm (6 15/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man in profile. He has a straight nose and prominent chin, with elaborately styled hair typical of the 18th century. The man is dressed formally, with a high-collared jacket or robe adorned with intricate details. There is a decorative bow at the back of his neck. The background has a cross-hatched texture and a circular frame around the portrait. Below the image, text identifies the subject as "CHARLES DUCLOS," with additional inscriptions in elegant script. The portrait is against a patterned backdrop, resembling engraving from the period.

artworks.title: Charles Jean Francois Henault
artworks.artist: Charles-Etienne Gaucher after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 31.3 x 23.9 cm (12 5/16 x 9 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a man facing left. He has a prominent nose, wavy hair styled for the time period, and wears a high-collared garment. The engraving is within an ornate rectangular frame with decorative elements. Below the portrait is an inscription with the man's name, Charles Jean François Hénault, and his titles.

artworks.title: Pierre Jeliote
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing a side profile of a man's head and shoulders. The man is positioned facing to the right. His facial features are finely detailed, with a prominent nose and chin. His hair is styled in a formal manner, gathered back and tied with a ribbon. He is wearing a garment that features a visible collar with a ruffled design at the neckline. There is a large decorative bow above the circular frame that encircles his profile. The background consists of a textured pattern. There is text beneath the image indicating the name "Pierre Jeliotte" and additional inscriptions about his professional titles.

artworks.title: N.B. Lepicie
artworks.artist: Jean Francois Rousseau after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in profile view from the chest up. The man is facing right, with his head slightly tilted upwards. He has a detailed facial profile with a strong nose and chin, and his hair is in an 18th-century style, tied back with a ribbon. He is dressed in a formal 18th-century garment. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with a draped cloth design at the top. Below the oval frame is a rectangular plaque inscribed with "N.B. Lépicié Professeur de l’Académie Royale de Peinture et de Sculpture." The engraving features cross-hatching details around the portrait and background, which is plain.

artworks.title: P.J. Marco
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showcasing a person's head and shoulders in profile within a circular frame. The individual faces to the right with distinct facial features, styled hair, and formal attire typical of the 18th century. The circular frame background is dark, with the top inscribed as "P. J. MARCO."

artworks.title: Three Feminine Heads
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of three faces shown in close-up from the neck upwards. The leftmost face is oriented slightly towards the viewer with a direct gaze, the central face looks downward with closed eyes, and the rightmost face is in profile with an upward tilt. All three faces have sculptural, classical features with prominent eyelids, smooth contours, and slightly parted lips. The hair is styled with soft curls. The medium used is red chalk on paper, giving the artwork a warm, monochromatic tone. There are no visible clothing or jewelry. The background of the sketch is simple and unadorned.

artworks.title: Ariadne
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on smooth wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a person standing gracefully, slightly turned to the side. They are holding a heart-shaped object close to their chest. The person has soft facial features, long hair with a garland of leaves and flowers, and is wearing a draped garment. The background is plain with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Penelope and Her Maids Weaving
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a weaving scene. It depicts multiple individuals working around a large loom. The attire suggests an ancient setting. The focus is on weaving and spinning thread, with various figures engaged in textile production. The setting includes architectural elements like columns and detailed backgrounds. Shadows and line work add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Divertissement from Voltaire's "La princesse de Navarre"
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from an elevated point of view, showing figures and architectural elements clearly. The horizon is implied by a grand structure resembling a temple or stage set, framed by tall columns in the distance. Several figures are on a path, some in elaborate costumes, hinting at a theatrical or historical theme. The artwork features loose, expressive brushstrokes with fine, fluid lines. The monochromatic color palette consists of rich sepia tones, offering a warm and classic feel. Close to us, figures are conversing, while in the distance, more architectural details emerge among trees, seamlessly blending with the scenery.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasies with Temples and Pyramids
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink with blue and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two circular architectural compositions side by side. The left composition displays a large domed building with a detailed facade, columns, and statues. An arched bridge-like structure is nearby, with a figure looking towards the scene. The right composition features grand steps leading to another domed edifice, surrounded by trees and decorative urns. Intricate colonnades and statues are present. Both scenes use fine lines, blue washes, sepia tones, and soft blues. The horizon is suggested by the arrangement of the architectural elements within the circular frames, without a defined landscape. Cursive inscriptions and ink blots are also present.

artworks.title: Classical Figures Gathered around an Urn
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper; black chalk sketches of mostly architecture on verso
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of abstract figures. The drawing features a cluster of figures arranged closely together. The lines are sketched with a fluid and loose style. Some figures appear to be leaning, sitting, or crouching, creating depth. The drawing captures emotion and complexity through subtle line variations. The background is left mostly untouched, focusing on the figures.

artworks.title: Mountain Heights, Cader Idris
artworks.medium: watercolor over chalk on oatmeal paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 47.7 x 74.6 cm (18 3/4 x 29 3/8 in.)
overall (mat size): 59.7 x 85.7 cm (23 1/2 x 33 3/4 in.)

artworks.title: Moses Delivering God's Commandments to the Israelites
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures in an outdoor setting with mountains and trees in the background. The central figure, whose legs and feet are visible, is standing and holding two large tablets. This person is facing other individuals to whom they are showing the tablets. This central figure has hair, a beard, and is wearing a long robe with intricate patterns. Surrounding this person are several other figures, most of whom are shown from the waist or knees up. One of the figures wears a turban, while others seem to be wearing different types of headgear. Their clothing includes draped garments, some with decorative details. Some individuals have beards, while others have simpler hairstyles. They are portrayed in a variety of poses, as if engaged in conversation or reacting to the central figure. The background features a landscape of hills and mountains, with a dome structure at the far end. Clouds are visible in the sky.

artworks.title: Amnon and Tamar
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of two people seen from the knees up. The person on the right is a bare-chested man with a muscular build, his head turned towards the left. His facial features are minimal, and he has short, curly hair. Cloth appears to drape and flow around his waist. The person on the left appears to be a woman who is facing the left with her head turned back towards the right, showing similarly minimal facial features. She also has curly hair and is nude, although she holds a large bundle of cloth in front of her. This cloth appears to be the same cloth that is wrapped around the man's waist.  The drawing is in reddish-brown chalk on a beige background.

artworks.title: A Woodland River with a Fisherman
artworks.medium: charcoal, chalk, and brushed washes with scratching out on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woodland scene with a calm stream or river. The perspective is from slightly above water level, with the surface of the water mirroring the surrounding trees. The horizon is hidden by the dense forest in the distance. A solitary figure stands in the forest. The trees are detailed with robust, curving trunks and branches extending outward, casting shadowy patterns. The brushstrokes emphasize texture and depth, with light and shadow creating complexity. The color palette is sepia-toned, lending the image a warm and timeless quality.

artworks.title: The Blind Hurdy Gurdy Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30 x 17.5 cm (11 13/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
support: 33.8 x 19.8 cm (13 5/16 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person standing and leaning slightly forward. The person has exaggerated facial features and long, unkempt hair under a soft cap. They wear a cloak, robe or tunic, and simple shoes. In their left hand, they hold a decorative cylindrical object, possibly a container or scroll. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines, serving as a backdrop.
